panes.title: WHY THAT GAP CLOSES
lines: kaspa cuts *twelve times a year*. bitcoin once every four years.

post.x: kaspa creates about $54.6K of new supply per day. bitcoin creates $34.55M, roughly 633 times more. kaspa cuts its reward twelve times a year and bitcoin once every four years, so that gap narrows every month without anyone voting on it.
post.reply: the full emission schedule is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. bitcoin issuance is 3.125 coins per block, about 144 blocks a day.
